bio: In their restaurant opposite the port of Audierne, this pair certainly broadens our culinary horizons. The chef is from Brazil and the floor manager hails from Finistère – the result is delicious, aromatic cuisine that will bring a smile to your lips. The chef naturally draws on the local pantry – most notably fish and seafood, to which she cleverly adds modern and exotic touches. The predominantly maritime score features a lineup illustrated by confit of seabass with grilled beetroot and a pomegranate dressing or seared scallops served with pearl barley, mango and a curry sauce. Pleasant colourful, contemporary interior and a terrace overlooking the port and marina....
